comparisons.evidence: Ta. cari similarity, suitability, agreement, exactness, rightness, propriety, regularity, equal measure or quantity; yes, right. Ma. sari, sari even, like, equal, right, correct. Ko. cery equal, good, right, correct; cerya'n excellent, beautiful, clever, very. To. sary right, correct; height. Ka. sari the state or condition of being adjusted, fitness, propriety, suitableness, rightness, correctness, evenness, sameness, similarity, equality, an equal thing, fit, proper, right, reasonable; vb. to put in proper order, adjust; sarikatana equality of position; sariga an equal, a man of equal power; saru sameness, equality. Kod. sëri correct. Tu. sari equal, like; just, right, proper, fit, even, not odd, full; interj. very good; sarike right, fit, proper, level, even, abundant, complete; sarta straight, direct; sarāriyuni to be exact; sarāsari equally, alike, right, proper, on average. Te. sari equal, equivalent, suitable, fit, proper, corresponding, similar, like, just like, reasonable, correct, right, faultless, straight, level, even, flat, not odd, completed, equality, similarity, etc.; yes, all right; (K also) sar(u)du, sarusu to distribute equally, (coll.) economize. Kui sarna straight, outstretched, upright. Kur. to put in its proper place, stow. Malt. saryare to be cured, be ready; saryatre to cure, mend, correct. Br. ? shar good, beautiful; well, properly (also Bal.). Skt. sadṛśa- like, resembling, suitable, fit. Pkt. sari- id.
